collocations.text: 未着品の残高を確認する
collocations.reason: Natural operational phrase used during month-end or year-end balance reconciliation.
Acceptable expression for reconciling goods in transit against shipping documents or ledgers.
『精算する』 applies to expenses, advances, or settlement of debts, not to inventory asset accounts like 未着品. When goods arrive, they are reclassified (振り替える) to 仕入 or 商品.
